svg.title: Sachi — faithful layered vector reconstruction
svg.desc: Dense, pixel-derived vector paths preserve the source PNG's colors and alpha. No embedded bitmap. Parts can be transformed independently. This is not a simplified Bezier redraw; source pixel geometry remains visible at high zoom. Hidden underpainting and closed-eye guides support restrained puppet animation. Left and right refer to screen directions.
